ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Adds an e2e job to test.yml: permissions contents:read, checkout with persist-credentials:false, only GitHub-owned actions (checkout, setup-node, upload-artifact) on tags as before, no secrets, no new third-party action. Playwright browsers come from npm ci (lockfile-pinned). Trust boundary unchanged; pinning of the existing third-party lcov-reporter action is filed as a triage card.
